professionalSummary: Product manager for Relaywire’s messaging API (Jan 2020‑Mar 2024) accountable for the API’s quarterly roadmap under the company’s product operating model. (src_d5f9ad61c48a)
experienceHighlights: Ran quarterly prioritisation reviews using API usage data and customer interview notes, recording each decision in the roadmap decision log. (src_27d2d3da0faf)

Signed launch‑readiness checklists for the batch‑send endpoint and webhook retries, holding the batch‑send launch for a week until support runbook and status‑page entries were ready. (src_a95a891fcdb9)
Worked with developer relations on reference documentation and release notes for Python and Node SDKs at each launch, reviewing code samples in the getting‑started guide. (src_957426303590)
Provided usage data and interview notes for the 2023 pricing change, including a summary of largest customers’ monthly volumes; the pricing committee set new tiers. (src_4e5d9f201ce0)
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: two pages of the roadmap decision log (Q2‑Q3 2023) and the signed launch‑readiness checklist for the batch‑send endpoint, with the candidate as signatory. (src_2ad4fdd78208)
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample documents establish the candidate’s accountability for an API product roadmap, documented prioritisation decisions, launch‑readiness management, collaboration with developer relations on documentation and SDKs, use of usage data and customer interviews for prioritisation, and leadership of a pricing change for an API product.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the Product Manager, Messaging API role.

evidence.text: Product manager for the messaging API at Relaywire from January 2020 to March 2024, accountable for the API's quarterly roadmap under the company's product operating model.

Signed the launch-readiness checklist for the batch-send endpoint and for webhook retries, holding the batch-send launch for a week until the support runbook and status-page entries were ready, and recorded the reason on the checklist.
Worked with developer relations on the reference documentation and the release notes for the Python and Node SDKs at each launch, and reviewed the code samples in the getting-started guide.
Ran the quarterly prioritisation review, using API usage data and customer interview notes, and recorded each accepted or deferred item with its rationale in the roadmap decision log.

Provided usage data and interview notes for the 2023 pricing change, including a summary of the largest customers' monthly volumes; the pricing committee, chaired by the commercial director, set the new tiers.

supportedClaims.witness: Worked with developer relations on the reference documentation and the release notes for the Python and Node SDKs at each launch, and reviewed the code samples in the getting-started guide.

supportedClaims.witness: Ran the quarterly prioritisation review, using API usage data and customer interview notes, and recorded each accepted or deferred item with its rationale in the roadmap decision log.

supportedClaims.witness: Provided usage data and interview notes for the 2023 pricing change, including a summary of the largest customers' monthly volumes; the pricing committee, chaired by the commercial director, set the new tiers.
